findings.action: Run 'pnpm install' to generate pnpm-lock.yaml, then git add it.
findings.description: No lockfile found. pnpm is used (node_modules/.pnpm exists) but pnpm-lock.yaml is missing. This breaks reproducible installs for CI and collaborators.
findings.title: Missing pnpm-lock.yaml

findings.description: Installed in dependencies but never imported in src/. The project uses @tanstack/react-query-persist-client with idb directly, not sync storage.
findings.title: Unused package: @tanstack/query-sync-storage-persister

findings.description: Installed in dependencies but never imported. The project uses nodemailer for email sending (src/lib/services/email-service.ts). Only the RESEND_API_KEY env var exists.
findings.title: Unused package: resend

findings.description: package.json has no 'packageManager' field. Collaborators and CI won't know which pnpm version to use.
findings.title: Missing packageManager field

findings.description: No .env.example file. New contributors have no reference for required env vars (SUPABASE_*, SMTP_*, SENTRY_*, etc.).
findings.title: Missing .env.example

findings.description: 9 one-off debugging scripts (check-mechanic4.ts, inspect-db.ts, etc.) are committed. scratch/ is excluded from biome but not from git.
findings.title: scratch/ tracked in git but not in .gitignore
